   Agenda Item No.: 6.A
  Mtg. Date: 11/16/2021

TO:  HONORABLE MAYOR AND MEMBERS OF THE CITY COUNCIL

FROM:  STEPHANIE GRANT , ADMINISTRATIVE CLERK

THRU:  ELAINE JENG P.E., CITY MANAGER

SUBJECT:
  VIEW PRESERVATION COMPLAINT - 61 EASTFIELD DRIVE (JUGE -
  COMPLAINANT) AND 59 EASTFIELD DRIVE (TAMAYO/SIERRA -
  VEGETATION OWNER)

DATE:  November 16, 2021

BACKGROUND:

At the Trees and Views meeting on November 2, 2021, at 5:30 p.m., the Committee on Trees and Views
determined there was a pre-existing view and that the view was impaired. The Committee determined
that the Vegetation owners shall restore the Complainants view. According to Section 17.26.040, the
view impairment dispute resolution process, in the event the Committee requires expert advice in
consideration of the matter, the cost of obtaining such evidence shall be borne by the complainant,
pursuant to written agreement with the City. The Committee decided to select the services on an expert
to assist with the decision of vegetation maintenance. The City shall select such expert and enter into an
agreement only upon receipt of a payment for the selected service from the complainant. The
Complainant agreed to pay for the services of the expert. The Committee used the sample resolution
prepared by the City Attorney's Office to guide its discussion and decision during the public hearing on
November 2, 2021. The Committee decided to continue the meeting at the Complainant's home to view
the vegetation on November 3, 2021 at 5:00 p.m.

On November 3, 2021 at 5:00 p.m. there was a Field Trip meeting held at the Complainant's home. All
three of the Committee Members were in attendance, also in attendance were Mr. Juge, Denise Jacobs
(resident), and Stephanie Grant (Code Enforcement Officer and Planner). Mr. Sierra and Dr. Tamayo
did not attend the field trip meeting, and they did not grant permission for anyone to enter onto their
property. The Committee viewed the vegetation and made recommendations for maintenance that will
be presented at a later date after the arborist presents his/her recommendations. The Field Trip meeting
was continued to November 9, 2021 at 5:30 p.m.

On November 9, 2021, the meeting was cancelled because the arborist (1st) the City selected was not
available to conduct a site visit or attend the evening meeting. The Committee on Trees and Views

  3
 rescheduled the meeting to Tuesday, November 16, 2021 at 5:30 p.m. to allow more time to find a
different arborist (2nd).
On November 10, 2021, the City selected a different arborist (2nd) and had entered into an agreement.
On November 12, 2021, the Complainant has decided to select a different arborist (3rd). At this time,
Complainant has not paid or entered into an agreement with the 2nd arborist that the City has selected.
The City is in the process of finding a 3rd arborist that will be affordable for the Complainant and meet
the City's requirements and certifications.

DISCUSSION:
This meeting is a continuation of the Committee on Trees and Views Field Trip meeting held on
November 3, 2021 at 5:00 p.m. at the Joe Juge's (Complainant) residence located at 61 Eastfield Drive.

FISCAL IMPACT:
None.

RECOMMENDATION:
Direct Staff to prepare resolution.
